kids.name: T2 reason (Apply)
kids.note: reason node: aria-describedby target, in the DOM at mount

kids.name: words
kids.chars: Apply, button, unavailable, Your role can't save workspaces.

node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT (seed 574) 1m series of 800 bars to the forming bar 14:05 UTC; tick and qty step from the recorded instrument fixture; volumes, deltas, trades, prices, the thresholds' example bounds and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No account data, key or balance. C-2.11 (R-1): the strip reads the live public trade stream on demo and live alike; no DEMO / LIVE badge and no environment control appears; nothing on this board differs by environment.

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Frames: SCR-033/no-row-selected, SCR-033/threshold-invalid, SCR-033/source-unavailable, SCR-033/view-as, SCR-033/apply-no-write

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark (exported as docs/design/E20/img/E20-D02-08-scr033-validation-source-unavailable.png); §0 L60: 10 boards, 0 light twins — the light and high-contrast renders are not drawn, the text is binding; every fill here is a neutral token, so the T2 and breach grammar holds under any theme switch

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Greyscale, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0): a wireframe — colour, type, iconography and elevation are E20-D03's

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §2 L137: no row selected — specified in §6.5 (board 08)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Every checkbox cleared: Apply is disabled as form validity, not T2 (§1.4; 14:870 "at least one row selected"): no lock and no reason key; it stays focusable with aria-disabled="true" and W-12 as its aria-describedby; a press changes nothing and re-announces W-12

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: W-12 names "Hide Deep Stats", the explicit action (MEMO C10, A5)

value-2.chars: A percent bound outside 0–100 (140) shows W-13; a unit-row bound that is not a number or is outside E20-S03's bounds shows W-29; each under its field, naming its row (§6.5)

value-3.chars: The field gets aria-invalid and is described by its message, shown on blur and on Apply; Apply stays enabled and focus moves to the first invalid field on press (Delta's, drawn focused)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §2 L139: source unavailable (T2 2a; CMP-079, CMP-019 lock) — specified in §6.5; §1.4 (board 08)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: On a symbol without open interest the OI Δ row stays in the list, T2 rendering 2a inline (§1.4; MEMO G8); never silently hidden (E20.json:394)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Its checkbox keeps its native role and full label "OI Δ" (G-T2.1a), aria-disabled="true", never disabled, in the roving row (G-T2.1b); the W-14 node is in the DOM at mount, linked by aria-describedby (G-T2.1c); CMP-079 RbacGate wraps it, CMP-019 lock ("Not available") leads the label (G-T2.1d)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Look (E09-D09 §2.1): color.surface.raised + a color.border.default hairline, label and lock color.text.tertiary, the reason its own line in color.text.secondary; never color.text.disabled or opacity.disabled, in every theme (forced colours: R2)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: The reason key deepstats.source_unavailable is PROPOSED, E17-D01 the vocabulary owner; W-14 is that owner's to word

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: §9 L340 OI Δ: live derivatives source (24:1199); D02-G2; bootstrap derivatives source (24:1199); D02-G2; history /market/metrics open_interest_delta (22:19167)

value-1.chars: §2 L140: view-as (T2 2a; CMP-079, CMP-019 lock) — specified in §1.4 (board 08)

value-2.chars: View-as is checked first (§1.4): one notice in the dialog header (R32:57) carries W-17 (rbac.view_as, E09-D09:95), Apply's aria-describedby target; Apply is T2 2a with the CMP-019 lock

value-3.chars: Every row control stays operable as a preview; nothing is saved

value-4.chars: Without workspaces:write the same rendering takes rbac.permission or rbac.owner_only (PROPOSED, D02-OQ2): SCR-033/apply-no-write

value-1.chars: §2 L141: Apply without workspaces:write (T2 2a; CMP-079, CMP-019 lock) — specified in §1.4 (board 08)

value-2.chars: Without workspaces:write (22:10588) Apply is T2 rendering 2a (§1.4): CMP-079 RbacGate, the CMP-019 lock leading the full label, the reason under Apply as its aria-describedby target, in the DOM at mount

value-3.chars: The reason key is rbac.permission or rbac.owner_only by E09-D09 §3.1's chooser, verb "save workspaces" (E09-D09:114); PROPOSED, D02-OQ2 (is Apply a template save?)

value-4.chars: Every row control stays operable as a preview; Enter or Space on Apply changes nothing and re-shows the reason with one polite announcement
